## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include a before/after example when useful.

## Validation

Record checks and results. For visible changes, include desktop/mobile and keyboard evidence. For auth, state or CMS changes, include the relevant persona/reviewer pack and native platform verification.

## Release and recovery

List configuration, content-model, seed or identity changes in deployment order. State whether marketing-owned content is affected and how to recover. Omit this section when no release steps are needed.
